C:P1.2.text: Cardinal Infrastructure Group is a civil infrastructure and site development services provider operating in the Southeast that is delivering integrity from the ground up.

C:P1.3.text: Civil Infrastructure Services, Delivering Integrity from the Ground Up

C:P1.4.text: Across the Southeast, the neighborhoods, commercial developments, roads and other infrastructure taking shape all start in the same place: the ground. Cardinal Infrastructure Group is a vertically integrated civil infrastructure and site development platform serving residential, commercial, industrial and municipal projects.

C:P1.5.text: Our operating companies self-perform site work from preconstruction to paving, including grading, site clearing, erosion control, underground utilities, drilling and blasting, and asphalt paving. Bringing multiple phases of the work under one accountable team gives our clients a single point of responsibility across the site.
